@graph.name: 5 Day Ijen, Bromo, Madakaripura & Malang City Adventure from Surabaya
@graph.description: Private 5-day tour from Surabaya: Ijen crater, Bromo sunrise, Madakaripura Waterfall, Malang city. East Java's best volcanic and cultural highlights.

@graph.name: Day 1: Surabaya to Bondowoso for Ijen Staging
@graph.description: The first day moves from Surabaya to the Bondowoso side so the Ijen segment can be handled properly. After hotel check-in, the required screening is completed before the climb window begins.

item.name: Surabaya to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Pickup by our team at your location in Surabaya. After meeting at the confirmed pick-up point, begin the overland transfer toward Bondowoso (Ijen area) as scheduled in the route plan.

item.name: Lunch at Local Restaurant
item.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch (cost not included). This is the planned meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

item.name: Local Restaurant to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Continue the overland journey from the restaurant toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

item.name: Check-in Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Arrive in Bondowoso and complete the hotel check-in process. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and the basic check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer.

item.name: Ijen health screening
item.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a scheduled screening session as listed in the itinerary to complete the required check before the Ijen-area program.

item.name: Dinner at Accommodation
item.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation or a nearby restaurant (included). This is the planned dinner time after the transfer and screening, scheduled as an included meal for the day.

@graph.name: Day 2: Ijen Climb and Transfer Toward the Bromo Side
@graph.description: After the Ijen sequence, the route continues west toward the Bromo side. This remains one of the heavier transfer days in the itinerary and works best when treated as part of the route logic, not as downtime.

item.name: Ijen Tour Experience
item.description: Follow the entire Ijen tour series. This block represents the full scheduled Ijen program as arranged for the day, completed in sequence before the onward transfer to the Bromo area later.

item.name: Return to Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Depart from the Ijen area after completing the hike and transfer back to the hotel in Bondowoso.

item.name: Ijen Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out from the Ijen area hotel. This is the formal check-out step after finishing the Ijen tour series, preparing for lunch and the transfer toward the Bromo area.

item.name: Lunch at Restaurant
item.description: Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (included). This is the planned meal break after hotel check-out, allowing time to sit down, eat, and reset before the overland drive to Bromo.

item.name: Journey to Bromo
item.description: Start the journey to the Bromo area (about 3-4 hours). This is the main overland transfer segment from the Ijen-area base (Bondowoso City) to the Bromo area accommodation zone.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-in
item.description: Arrive in Bromo area, check-in hotel. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and completing check-in so you can rest and prepare for the next day’s Bromo program.

@graph.name: Day 3: Bromo Sunrise, Madakaripura, and Continue to Malang
@graph.description: The route completes the Bromo sunrise sequence and Madakaripura before continuing to Malang. This day combines strong East Java contrast while still giving the itinerary a more comfortable city finish afterward.

item.name: Bromo Jeep Tour
item.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the scheduled early-morning Jeep-based Bromo sunrise program, completing the Mount Bromo touring block within the allocated time window before continuing to the next destination.

item.name: Breakfast at Hotel
item.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return from the Bromo program to the hotel and take the planned breakfast break, allowing time to refresh before check-out and transfer to Madakaripura.

item.name: Check-out and Transfer to Madakaripura
item.description: Check-out, travel to Madakaripura Waterfall. Complete hotel check-out in the Bromo area and begin the transfer to Madakaripura Waterfall, moving to the canyon-waterfall segment of the day.

item.name: Madakaripura Trekking
item.description: Arrive at Madakaripura and start trekking. Arrive at the Madakaripura area and begin the scheduled trekking session, using the allocated time for on-site exploration of the waterfall area as planned.

item.name: Finish explore Madakaripura waterfall
item.description: Finish explore Madakaripura waterfall. Conclude the trekking and exploration segment at Madakaripura, regroup at the meeting point, and transition to the next transfer leg according to schedule.

item.name: Transfer to Malang
item.description: Start the journey to Malang (about 3-4 hours). Depart from the Madakaripura area and begin the overland transfer to Malang, using the planned travel time for the afternoon relocation.

item.name: Check-in at Malang Hotel
item.description: Arrive in Malang, check-in hotel. Reach Malang and complete hotel check-in, concluding the day’s program upon arrival at the accommodation.

@graph.name: Day 4: Malang and Batu Exploration with Return Toward Surabaya
@graph.description: The fourth day shifts away from strict mountain rhythm and gives room for Malang and Batu-based exploration before returning toward Surabaya. It works best for guests who value a softer closing segment after the core route is complete.

item.name: Check-out Malang Hotel
item.description: Check-out from Malang hotel. Complete check-out procedures and prepare for departure to begin the day tour route before the return to Surabaya.

item.name: Malang to Batu Tour Start
item.description: Starting the tour to the Batu area. Begin the transfer from Malang toward Batu City, starting the day’s touring sequence in the Batu area within the allocated time block.

item.name: Lunch in Batu
item.description: Lunch in Batu (cost not included). Take the planned lunch break in Batu, with time to dine and rest before departing toward Surabaya later in the day.

item.name: Batu to Surabaya Transfer
item.description: Transfer to Surabaya City. Depart Batu and start the overland transfer to Surabaya, shifting from the Batu area touring segment to the final return leg.

item.name: Arrival in Surabaya
item.description: Arrive in Surabaya, transfer to hotel/airport. Complete arrival in Surabaya and proceed with the final drop-off to the requested hotel or airport location. Tour ends after drop-off.

@graph.name: Day 5: Surabaya Hotel Finish and Airport Transfer
@graph.description: The final day is reserved for a calmer Surabaya finish and airport handoff. This structure helps the route end cleanly without forcing a same-day rush immediately after the major volcano sequence.

item.name: Breakfast and Free Time
item.description: Breakfast at the hotel and free time until check-out time. This block is reserved for your morning meal and unstructured time at the hotel before the scheduled airport transfer.

item.name: Transfer to Juanda Airport
item.description: Pick up at your hotel lobby (planned 3 hours before your flight departure time) and transfer to Juanda Airport. This segment covers the direct road transfer to the airport for your departure connection.
